Invoke the `change-boot` skill.

One of the five **class boots** surfaced by `team-boot`'s Class Boots
catalog. `team-boot` injects the always-relevant team context (constitution,
CDR index, skills registry) at session start; this skill loads the
**change history layer** on demand — the published ChDR index mined from
git history — and pairs it with a capture suggestion so change rationale is
recovered (`/change-init` for mined history, `/change-specify` for decisions
made this session) rather than living only in commit messages. The boot
never writes files: it suggests the capture skill, and the user runs it.

Reading past rationale and recording new rationale are one loop: published
ChDRs explain why the code looks the way it does; rationale discovered
during the work flows back into the same record system through the capture skills.
